purpose: Teach: フロリダ/クリントン/信長/ヘンリー/ハンター/つくば/赤坂/ミクロ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフロリダに駐在された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he was stationed in Florida…
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gazing backward into memory. Gentle pace, almost thinking aloud. Slight lift of affection in the voice. Trailing-off suggests more he could say but won't push.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、クリントン政権時代を懐かしまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — you missed those Clinton years, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gently teasing. Leaning in slightly, as if reminding him of something he's told her before. The familiarity of a long partnership. 'Dear' lands with soft affection, not sweetness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが織田信長の本をご愛読された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he was always reading about Nobunaga…
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. A memory surfacing unbidden. Quiet certainty in the middle of the sentence — he remembers this clearly. Tender landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ヘンリー王子のニュースをご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were always watching the news about Prince Henry, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful knowing smile in the voice. She's gently catching him in his patterns, his habits. Warm, not mocking. The 'dear' is like a nudge — affectionate correction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがハンター仲間と山に入られた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he'd go into the mountains hunting with his mates…
lines.style: Wistful as before but with a thread of admiration now. The image of a younger man doing these things. Slower on 'hunting' — seeing it clearly. Soft fadeout on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、つくば万博に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you went to the Tsukuba Expo, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, patient warmth. She's building the picture alongside him — her own memories meeting his. 'Dear' carries the weight of shared history. Settling tone, like placing a piece into place.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが赤坂のクラブで商談された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he'd close business deals at those clubs in Akasaka…
lines.style: Wistful, almost proud now. The particularity of 'Akasaka clubs' — a specific world. Steady mid-voice, not wistful for loss but for a time. Slight breath before the final phrase.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ミクロの世界の本がお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You always loved those books about the microscopic world, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Tender, knowing smile fully present now. She's offering him his own memory back to him — lovingly. The 'dear' is intimate, closing. Soft, warm fadeout that says: I remember too.
